name: Hines Elevate
summary: The project (marketed as Conscient Hines Elevate / Elevate by Hines), Sector 59 Golf Course Extension Road location, 7.78 acres, 5 towers, 556 units and ~₹5 Cr starting price are confirmed. Our RERA number (RC/HARERA/GGM/2019/10) does not match the registrations sources cite (GGM/325/57/2019/19 and GGM/459/191/2021/27). The developer is a Conscient Infrastructure–Hines joint development, not Hines alone. Status and possession are phase-dependent: Phase 1 was ready around Dec 2024–Jan 2025 and the remaining phase is cited for Jan 2026. The largest 4 BHK is 3,395 sq ft, not 3,300.
